parameters.content:
## Track Which Sources ChatGPT Cites for Buyer Queries with GPT-4o Search and Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow runs weekly to measure which sources ChatGPT cites for a set of buyer queries. It reads queries from Google Sheets, creates three sample runs per query, asks ChatGPT with web search, extracts cited URLs, then aggregates citation frequency and hit rate by domain. It classifies each cited domain and appends the final citation metrics back to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Weekly Trigger with the desired run schedule.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and set the input spreadsheet/range for the buyer query set in the Read Query Set node.
- Configure the OpenAI HTTP Request nodes with a valid API key, model, endpoint, and prompts for web-search querying and domain classification.
- Set the output spreadsheet/range in the Append Citations node and confirm the sheet columns match the aggregated citation fields.

### Customization

Adjust the fan-out code to change the number of samples per query, update the prompts or model used for search and classification, or modify the aggregation code to track additional metrics such as URL-level counts or source categories.

## Schedule and load queries

Starts the workflow on a weekly schedule and reads the configured buyer query set from Google Sheets.

## Prepare sample runs

Expands each query into three sample runs and feeds them through a batch loop for repeated execution.

## Run search citations

Calls ChatGPT with web search for each sample query, then extracts URL citation annotations from the response before returning control to the loop.

## Aggregate and save sources

After all samples complete, aggregates citations by query and domain, classifies each domain with OpenAI, merges the classifications back into the aggregated rows, and appends the results to Google Sheets.
